m: इद् ind. Ved. (probably the neut. form of the pronom. base इ See 3. इ; a particle of affirmation) even, just, only

indeed, assuredly (especially, in strengthening an antithesis, e.g. यथा वशन्ति देवास् तथेद् असत्, as the gods wish it, thus indeed it will be, RV. viii, 28, 4; दिप्सन्त इद् रिपवो नाह देभुः, the enemies wishing indeed to hurt were in nowise able to hurt, RV. i, 147, 3). इद् is often added to words expressing excess or exclusion (e.g. विश्व इत्, every one indeed; शश्वद् इत्, constantly indeed; एक इत्, one only). At the beginning of sentences it often adds emphasis to pronouns, prepositions, particles (e.g. त्वम् इत्, thou indeed; यदि इत्, if indeed, &c.) इद् occurs often in the Ṛg-veda and Atharva-veda, seldom in the Brāhmaṇas, and its place is taken in classical Sanskṛt by एव and other particles.
a: इद् — ind. 1 A particle of affirmation, even, just, only; especially in strengthening a statement; अर्थज्ञ इत्सकलं भद्रमश्नुते Nir. --2 It is often added to words expressing excess or exclusion; विश्व इत्, एक इत् &c. --3 At the beginning of sentences it often adds emphasis to pronouns, prepositions &c. (Its place is taken by एव in classical Sanskrit).

a: इदं — pron. a. [अयं m., इयं f., इदं n.] 1 This here, referring to something near the speaker; (इदमस्तु संनिकृष्टं रूपं); इदं तत्… इति यदुच्यते Ś. 5 here is the truth of the saying. --2 Present, seen; the nominative forms are used with verbs in the sense of ‘here’; इयमस्मि here am I; so इमे स्मः; अयमागच्छामि here I come. --3 It often refers to something immediately following, while एतद् refers to what precedes; अनुकल्पस्त्वयं ज्ञेयः सदा सद्भिरनुष्टितः . Ms. 3. 147 (अयं = वक्ष्यमाणः Kull.); श्रुत्वैतदिदमूचुः. --4 It occurs connected with यत्, तत्, एतद्, अदस्, किं or a personal pronoun, either to point out anything more distinctly and emphatically, or sometimes pleonastically; कोयमाचरत्यविनयं Ś. 1. 25; सेयं, सोयं, this here; so इमास्ताः; अयमहं भोः Ś. 4 ho, here am I. --ind. Ved. 1 Here, to this place. --2 Now. --3 There. --4 With these words, herewith. --Comp. --प्रथम a. doing anything for the first time. --प्रकारं ind. in this manner. --युगं the present Yuga. --रूप a. of this shape. --वसु a. Ved. rich in this and that.

v: idam

tri॰ idi--kami nalomaSca 1 purovarttini 2 dfSye 3 budDyopasTApite “idamastu sannikfzwaM samIpavartti cEtadorUpam । adasasta viprakfzwam taditi parokze vijAnIyAt” ityukteH sannikfzwavAcitvaBasya ataeva “asyeti pratyakzAdisanniDApitasya jagata idamA nidaSaH” SA॰ BA॰ uktam । sannikfzwatvaYca budDimAtreRa, tacca jYAnalakzaRayA smaraRAdinA ca Bavati tena “kOmudIyaM viracyate” ityatra BAvinyAmapi kOmudyAM budDyA sanniDApitatvena idaMSabdaprayAgaH । ataeva tadAdeH budDisTatvopalakzitaDarmmAvacCinne Saktisiti nEyAyikAdayaH । tAdfSArTaparatve evAsya sarvvanAmatA SabdasvarUpaparatve tu na । “idamo'nvAdeSe” pA॰ “idamA nirdeScaH” SA॰ BA॰ “idamastu sannikfzwam” “ayamudayati vitatordDaraSmijAlaH” bAGaH । “ayamaYcati paYcaSarAnucaraH” sA॰ da॰ wI॰ “idaM kilAvyAjamanoharaM vapuH” Saku॰ “ayamasO BagavAnuta pARqavaH” kirA॰ । “inaM vivyasvate yogam” gItA “imaM lokaM mAtfBaktyA pitF BaktyA tu maDyamam” manuH । anvAdeSe enAdeSaH dvitIyAwossu “enaM yuvAnaM patiM vaH” iti vfzotsargamantraH” । “yadyenamujJasi tadA katarovaraste” nEza॰ । “anena yUnA saha pArTivena” raGuH । anUktO enena । evam anayoH enayoH । sarvvanAmakAryyam । ime asmE asmAt ezAm asmin striyAm iyam । “iyaM mahendrABftInaDiSriyaH” kumA॰ “itIyaM vEdikI SrutiH” manuH । asyEH asyAH AsAm । atrAkac । imakO imakenetyAdi pratyakzavizayatayAsmacCabdArTe'sya kvacit vfttiH “ayaM janaH prazwumanAstapoDane!” “jano'yamuccEH padalaNGranotsukaH” “itaH sa dEtyaH prAptaSrIrnetaevArhati kzayam” kumA॰ । iha । Tamu itTam TAl itTA । dAnIm idAnIm । tral atra tasil itaH । ayam avyayamapi । tena wyula tuwca । idantanaH । mayaw idasmayaH । striyAM NIp । vati iyAn striyAm NIp iyatI ।
m: 1. इदम् अयम्, इयम्, इदम् (fr. इद्, Uṇ. iv, 156; g. सर्वादि, Pāṇ. i, 1, 27; Vop.; a kind of neut. of the pronom. base 3. इ with अम् [cf. Lat. is, ea, id, and idem]; the regular forms are partly derived from the pronom. base अ; see Gr. 224; the Veda exhibits various irregular formations, e.g. fr. pronom. base अ, an inst. एना, अया [used in general adverbially], and gen. loc. du. अयोस्, and perhaps also अवोस्, in RV. vi, 67, 11; vii, 67, 4; x, 132, 5 [BRD.]; fr. the base इम, a gen. sing. इमस्य, only, RV.; the RV. has in a few instances the irregular accentuation अस्मै, v, 39, 5, &c.; अस्य, iv, 15, 5, &c.; आभिस्, vi, 25, 2, &c. : the forms derived fr. अ are used enclitically if they take the place of the third personal pronoun, do not stand at the beginning of a verse or period, and have no peculiar stress laid upon them), this, this here, referring to something near the speaker
known, present

(opposed to अदस्, e.g. अयं लोकः or इदं विश्वम् or इदं सर्वम्, this earthly world, this universe; अयम् अग्निः, this fire which burns on the earth; but असाव् अग्निः, that fire in the sky, i.e. the lightning: so also इदम् or इयम् alone sometimes signifies ‘this earth’; इमे स्मः, here we are.) इदम् often refers to something immediately following, whereas एतद् points to what precedes (e.g. श्रुत्वैतद् इदम् ऊचुः, having heard that they said this). इदम् occurs connected with यद्, तद्, एतद्, किम्, and a personal pronoun, partly to point out anything more distinctly and emphatically, partly pleonastically (e.g. तद् इदं वाक्यम्, this speech here following ; सो ऽयं विदूषकः, this Vidūṣaka here).
2. इदम् ind. [Ved. and in a few instances in classical Sanskṛt] here, to this place
now, even, just
there

in this manner, R. ii, 53, 31; Śak. (v.l. for इति in किम् इति जोषम् आस्यते, 202, 8).

having this as the first or best
being by this the first Comm. on Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162.

idantA
strI idamo BAvaH । idaMSabdArTaBAve aNgulyAdinA darSanayogyatAyAm “anirddeSyamiti” SrutipadavyAKyAne “idantayAnirddezwumaSakyam” BAzyam ।
m: इदन्—ता f. the being this, identity, Sarvad.

v: idantana
tri॰ asmin kAle BavaH ni॰ wyul tuw ca । idAnontane “SaktvihInaridantanEH” vfha॰ smftiH ।
m: इदन्—तन mfn. being now, living in this time Comm. on Mn. ix, 68.
इदन्—तृतीय mfn. doing this for the third time Comm. on Pāṇ. vi, 2, 162.

v: iduvatsara
pu॰ id--u vatsaraH । idAvatsare । “iduvatsarAya parivatsarAya saMvatsarAya” aTa॰ 6, 55, 3 ।

s: puM, idAvatsaraH । yaTA, -- “saMvatsarastu praTamo dvitIyaH parivatsaraH । idvatsarastftIyastu caturTastvanuvatsaraH ॥ paYcamo vatsarastezAM tadeBiH paYcaBiryugaM । tezu saMvatsaro hyagniH sUryyastu parivatsaraH ॥ soma idvatsarastezAM vAyuScEvAnuvatsaraH । rudrastu vatsaro jYeyaH paYcAvdA ye yugAtmakAH” ॥ iti devIpurARe kAlavyavasTAnAmADyAyaH ॥
